messages.subject: dart to genalex
parts:
Hello, 

I had this question a few days ago but then figured out a way to do it and wanted to post it in case anyone needs to do this as well. 

I had to get the DArT SNP data into genalex format for my lab group. For that I had to generate some genalex formatted csv's and it's actually quite simple.

All you want is to transform the genlight format to a genind format and then use package poppr to transform the genind to genalex format. 


install.packages('poppr')
library(poppr)

## read in your dart file 
gl.data <-  gl.read.dart(filename = 'Report_SNP_singlerow.csv', ind.metafile = 'meta.csv')

## transform genlight to genind
genind.data <- gl2gi(gl.data, v=2)

## transform genind to genalex format and save as csv file in your working directory using poppr. Important is to set sequence = TRUE
genind2genalex(genind.data, filename = 'SNP_as_genalex.csv', sequence = TRUE, overwrite = FALSE)

This might not be the most elegant way but it works. If there is another option let me know :-)
I guess you can do most things that you'd do in genalex in DartR but I haven't figured it all out yet. 


Cheers, 
Katrin

parts:
Thanks Katrin. Simple solution. We try not to duplicate existing functionality, so a good way to do it. I have added a gl2genalex script to the developmental version based on your approach. It will appear in the next release.

Arthur
